mapper.select: select id, soundItemId, title, lang, format, OCTET_LENGTH(content) as size, enabled, createTime from vpn.sound_subtitle where soundItemId=#{soundItemId} and enabled=1 order by id asc
select id, content, format, lang from vpn.sound_subtitle where id=#{id} and enabled=1 limit 1
select id, soundItemId, title, lang, format, sourceFileHash, genStatus, engine, enabled, createTime from vpn.sound_subtitle where soundItemId=#{soundItemId} limit 1

select s.id, s.baseurl, s.url, s.name, s.file, s.fileDate, s.myFile, s.channel from vpn.sounditems s left join vpn.sound_subtitle t on t.soundItemId = s.id where t.id is null order by s.id desc limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update vpn.sound_subtitle set genStatus=#{genStatus} where id=#{id}
